findings.quoted_text: Client has the unilateral right to cancel this agreement at any time within a 7-day notice period.

The Developer expressly acknowledges and agrees that any all proprietary materials prepared by the Developer under this Agreement shall be considered "works for hire" and the exclusive property of the Client unless otherwise specified.
Client has the unilateral right to cancel this agreement at any time within a 7-day notice period.
findings.explanation: The client can terminate the agreement unilaterally on short notice while your termination rights are much more restricted, creating an unbalanced relationship.
findings.suggested_change: Either Party may terminate this Agreement at any time upon seven (7) days' prior written notice to the other Party.

findings.quoted_text: The Developer expressly acknowledges and agrees that any all proprietary materials prepared by the Developer under this Agreement shall be considered "works for hire" and the exclusive property of the Client unless otherwise specified.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights transfer to the client immediately upon creation as a work-for-hire, before you are guaranteed full payment for your work.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in the deliverables shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment of all compensation due under this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, I hope this email finds you well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before we proceed with signing.

- Regarding the termination terms, the current wording allows only the client to cancel on short notice. Please update the relevant clause to state that either party may terminate this agreement at any time upon seven days' prior written notice to the other party.
- Regarding the intellectual property clause, the current terms transfer ownership immediately before payment is guaranteed. Please update the relevant clause so that all intellectual property rights in the deliverables transfer to the client only upon receipt of full payment of all compensation due under this agreement.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. I look forward to moving forward once these updates are made.

Best regards
